result.instructions: Tools for Billify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which clients in Billify have an offer that is still open?"; "Create an offer for Muster Gartenbau: 12 months of garden care at CHF 180 per month."; "Show me the overdue invoices and their amounts.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Billify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. billify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billify_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the newest 100 clients of the company, without deleted ones. Billify has no paging and no filter in its API: company_name matches only those 100, without case. Use it before creating a client. Billify API: GET /api/v1/clients.

company_name.description: Only clients whose company name contains this text (no case).

tools.name: billify_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with its contact details, address, language and the number of its invoices and offers. Billify API: GET /api/v1/clients/{id}.

tools.name: billify_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client. First searches the newest 100 clients: a company name that matches (no case) returns that client and creates nothing. Billify also answers 409 for an existing name, and this tool then returns that client. Duplicates are never created: Billify's allowDuplicate option is not offered. Billify API: POST /api/v1/clients.

company_name.description: Company name. Billify matches an existing client by this name, without case.

language.description: Language of the client's documents. Omit to use the company language.

notes.description: Internal notes. Not shown to the client.

tools.name: billify_list_offers
tools.title: List offers
tools.description: List the newest 100 offers with their line items. Billify has no paging and no filter in its API: client_id and status match only those 100. Billify API: GET /api/v1/offers.

client_id.description: Only records of this client id.

tools.name: billify_get_offer
tools.title: Get an offer
tools.description: Get one offer by id, with its line items, status, amounts and dates. Billify API: GET /api/v1/offers/{id}.

tools.name: billify_create_offer
tools.title: Create an offer
tools.description: Create an offer as a DRAFT for an existing client. Billify sets the offer number, computes each total and amount, and ignores any amount sent, so none are sent. The offer is not sent to the client: the user sends it in Billify after checking the preview. The response includes appUrl. Billify API: POST /api/v1/offers.

details.description: Text under the line item name.

unit.description: Unit, for example Stk, Std. or Pauschale. Omit for Stk.

unit_price.description: Price per unit, excluding VAT, as a decimal in the document currency (e.g. 1250.5). Not in cents.

items.description: Line items, in order. Billify computes each total.

offer_date.description: Offer date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent: 8.1, 2.6, 3.8 or 0. Omit for 8.1 (0 for companies without VAT).

language.description: Document language. Omit to use the client's language.

currency.description: CHF or EUR. Omit for CHF.

billing_type.description: ONE_TIME, or MONTHLY for recurring billing.

billing_months.description: Number of months. Only with billing_type MONTHLY.

tools.name: billify_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the newest 100 invoices with their line items. Invoices cannot be created, sent, changed or deleted through this API. Billify has no paging and no filter: client_id and status match only those 100. Billify API: GET /api/v1/invoices.

client_id.description: Only records of this client id.

tools.name: billify_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its line items, status, dates, amounts, payment status and QR reference. Billify API: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.
